CustomObject.description: One QuickBooks Online webhook event, stored by the public endpoint exactly as received and before any interpretation. A scheduled job reads the QuickBooks transaction it refers to and turns ACH/wire money into Pending Transactions. Kept after processing as the record of which QuickBooks transactions Salesforce has already seen, so a pending transaction deleted by staff is never imported again. JSI-121 / Jason Ott.
CustomObject.label: QuickBooks Event
